Q13.purpose: Assess whether organic traffic decline aligns with organic order decline by comparing sessions to orders and revenue

SELECT t.month,
       t.total_sessions,
       t.total_product_page_views,
       o.total_orders,
       o.total_revenue
FROM (
    SELECT date_format(to_date(date), 'yyyy-MM') AS month,
           SUM(sessions) AS total_sessions,
           SUM(product_page_views) AS total_product_page_views
    FROM `WHYDROP_FILES`.web_traffic
    WHERE source = 'organic'
      AND date_format(to_date(date), 'yyyy-MM') IN ('2026-08', '2026-09')
    GROUP BY month
) t
JOIN (
    SELECT date_format(to_date(date), 'yyyy-MM') AS month,
           SUM(quantity) AS total_orders,
           SUM(unit_price_usd * quantity) AS total_revenue
    FROM `WHYDROP_FILES`.orders
    WHERE channel = 'organic'
      AND date_format(to_date(date), 'yyyy-MM') IN ('2026-08', '2026-09')
    GROUP BY month
) o
ON t.month = o.month
ORDER BY t.month;

Q22.purpose: Calculate each country's revenue drop in September vs August and its share of the total September‑August revenue decline.
Q22.sql:
SELECT country,
       SUM(CASE WHEN month='2026-09' THEN revenue_usd ELSE 0 END) -
       SUM(CASE WHEN month='2026-08' THEN revenue_usd ELSE 0 END) AS rev_change_usd,
       SUM(CASE WHEN month='2026-09' THEN orders ELSE 0 END) -
       SUM(CASE WHEN month='2026-08' THEN orders ELSE 0 END) AS order_change,
       ROUND(
           (SUM(CASE WHEN month='2026-09' THEN revenue_usd ELSE 0 END) -
            SUM(CASE WHEN month='2026-08' THEN revenue_usd ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 /
           NULLIF(
               (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN month='2026-09' THEN revenue_usd ELSE 0 END) -
                      SUM(CASE WHEN month='2026-08' THEN revenue_usd ELSE 0 END)
               FROM (
                   SELECT date_format(to_date(date), 'yyyy-MM') AS month,
                          SUM(unit_price_usd * quantity) AS revenue_usd
                   FROM WHYDROP_FILES.orders
                   WHERE country IN ('US','GB','IN','CA','DE','AU')
                     AND date_format(to_date(date), 'yyyy-MM') IN ('2026-08','2026-09')
                   GROUP BY month
               )
           ), 1),
           2) AS pct_of_total_drop
FROM (
    SELECT o.country,
           date_format(to_date(o.date), 'yyyy-MM') AS month,
           SUM(o.unit_price_usd * o.quantity) AS revenue_usd,
           COUNT(*) AS orders
    FROM WHYDROP_FILES.orders o
    WHERE o.country IN ('US','GB','IN','CA','DE','AU')
      AND date_format(to_date(o.date), 'yyyy-MM') IN ('2026-08','2026-09')
    GROUP BY o.country, month
) sub
GROUP BY country
ORDER BY rev_change_usd DESC;
Q22.sql_original:
SELECT country,
       SUM(CASE WHEN month='2026-09' THEN revenue_usd ELSE 0 END) -
       SUM(CASE WHEN month='2026-08' THEN revenue_usd ELSE 0 END) AS rev_change_usd,
       SUM(CASE WHEN month='2026-09' THEN orders ELSE 0 END) -
       SUM(CASE WHEN month='2026-08' THEN orders ELSE 0 END) AS order_change,
       ROUND(
           (SUM(CASE WHEN month='2026-09' THEN revenue_usd ELSE 0 END) -
            SUM(CASE WHEN month='2026-08' THEN revenue_usd ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 /
           NULLIF(
               (SELECT SUM(revenue_usd) FROM (
                   SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN month='2026-09' THEN revenue_usd ELSE 0 END) -
                          SUM(CASE WHEN month='2026-08' THEN revenue_usd ELSE 0 END) AS total_drop
                   FROM (
                       SELECT date_format(to_date(date), 'yyyy-MM') AS month,
                              SUM(unit_price_usd * quantity) AS revenue_usd
                       FROM WHYDROP_FILES.orders
                       WHERE country IN ('US','GB','IN','CA','DE','AU')
                         AND date_format(to_date(date), 'yyyy-MM') IN ('2026-08','2026-09')
                       GROUP BY month
                   ) t
               )) , 1),
           2) AS pct_of_total_drop
FROM (
    SELECT o.country,
           date_format(to_date(o.date), 'yyyy-MM') AS month,
           SUM(o.unit_price_usd * o.quantity) AS revenue_usd,
           COUNT(*) AS orders
    FROM WHYDROP_FILES.orders o
    WHERE o.country IN ('US','GB','IN','CA','DE','AU')
      AND date_format(to_date(o.date), 'yyyy-MM') IN ('2026-08','2026-09')

) sub
